display.role: Cold-start masthead + section display, used with restraint; steps aside for the champion font on populated pages.

text.role: Controls, labels, buttons, body/UI. Not Inter, not Söhne.

mono.role: Instrument voice — genome credits, weight·px·tracking labels, run metadata.

champion.role: The user's current generated font. Sets specimen text and the single detail-page H1 ONLY — never nav/controls/buttons.
champion.load: gate on document.fonts.ready; server-computed size-adjust/ascent-override/descent-override at mint; metrics-matched fallback revealed by ~600ms

ink.intent: Warm near-black; reads as ink on both grounds.

paper.intent: Warm publishing ground. A foundry catalogue is warm paper.

muted.intent: Dim and fainter ink for metadata, labels, whispered copy.

accent.name: Proof Red
accent.intent: Press-registration red. RESERVED to two jobs only: the Breed action and the Keep state. 1px ring or solid dot, never a glow.

signal.intent: Warm graphite for the in-flight/minting instrument state (progress, generating). Kept distinct from accent so progress never borrows the Breed red.

density.judging: comparison-dense and fast — grid, not full-bleed; 1-9 keyboard picking intact
density.publishing: spacious — the vertical rhythm of a printed catalogue

rules.seamRule: one 2px rule only, reserved for the specimen-hero/metadata seam

motion.budget: micro-states in the loop, one orchestrated moment

signature.name: lineage morph
signature.detail: parent→child point-cloud interpolation; the one orchestrated moment
signature.perf: batch fillRects into Path2D, parse/resample in a Worker, pause rAF off-screen

motion.rules: compositor-only transforms (translate/opacity/clip-path); no viewport-wide filter/box-shadow; prefers-reduced-motion degrades the morph to a crossfade

bench.intent: JUDGING ground — flat cool near-white, no warmth. The font is the only variable; keeps hairline/monoline faces legible while receding.

paper.intent: PUBLISHING ground — warm paper. Editorial richness where trust is earned.

line.intent: Hairline rules — the structural motif is the rule, not the filled box.

surface.assignment: structural per-surface via a `surface` prop; NEVER a user toggle
surface.elevation: none — hairline rules instead of shadows; no glows (glows read as gamer-UI)
